Maj. Marshall Coen (right), a Killeen, Texas, native and chaplain for the 1st "Ironhorse" Brigade Combat Team, 1st Cavalry Division, baptizes a Soldier during his deployment with the 1st Battalion, 504th Parachute Infantry Regiment, 82nd Airborne Division, Jan. 24, 2010, at Al Asad Air Base, Iraq. Coen recalled the baptism as one of many rewarding moments of his career, but said his most rewarding moment was coming home from deployment and seeing his wife and family. The father of three boys, Coen said his greatest accomplishment is his family. (Photo courtesy of Maj. Marshall Coen, 1st BCT, 1st Cav. Div.)
